verdict.rationale: Scheduling recurring jobs or workflows is a fair question for an observability platform, for example scheduled queries or reports, so the axis applies. The evidence offers only adjacent features: threshold-based Triggers and SLO alerts (honeycomb-docs-6, honeycomb-docs-8) and an API for building your own automation (honeycomb-docs-11). None of it documents a user-defined recurring schedule for jobs or workflows, so the verdict is none rather than partial.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
